content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Fort Wayne

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and completion of project management education hours—but no prior work experience. If you hold a high school diploma or equivalent and are ready to formalize your project management knowledge, you meet the foundational requirement to begin.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of PM Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. This intensive format compresses core project management frameworks and processes into an efficient schedule, allowing you to earn your required contact hours while maintaining your current work commitments in Fort Wayne's dynamic job market.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your education hours, submit your official application to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy guides you through this process, ensuring your documentation is complete and your account is ready for exam scheduling.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources to reinforce key concepts and test-taking strategies. When you are confident, schedule your proctored exam and demonstrate your command of project management fundamentals to earn your credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Certification
steps_items.text: CAPM credentials renew on a three-year cycle. Earn professional development units through training, volunteer work, or conference attendance to keep your certification active and stay current with evolving project management practices and standards.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
